Initial release of hr-talk-compass — an HR assistant for employee conversations and OD insights.

- Supports employee 1:1 prep, critical conversation rehearsal, and post-talk analysis using Stanford "Designing Your Life" frameworks.
- Offers four tailored workflows: quick briefing, deep dialogue, manager toolkit, and review/insights.
- Emphasizes coaching principles, employee perspective, and ethical HR boundaries.
- Provides structured, repeatable methods for both HRs and business managers.
- Includes guidance for documentation and organizing talk records for ongoing organizational diagnostics.
